::: {.two-column-section tag="section"}
## Supervision

::: layout-block
I supervise doctoral research and master’s theses in econometrics. Between 2019 and 2025, I supervised more than 50 master’s students at Aarhus University.

My doctoral supervision includes D. Delfino, G. Rizzelli, F. Okslund, P. Vallarino, F. Krabbe, and J. Steenbergen, as well as co-supervision of E. Mensali at the University of Bologna.

[Research group →](group.qmd){.text-link}
:::
:::

::: endnote
Enrolled students can find course materials on Brightspace. For course-related questions, [contact me by email](mailto:leopoldo.catania@econ.au.dk).
:::
